data.overview: Mastermind Viktor Voss and his criminal circle steal private market intelligence to rig a fortune. Voss adopts a string of disguises, using a nightclub singer as his messenger and a young heir as his next mark. As Inspector Rehn follows the trail, he must find a way to expose a criminal who seems to be everywhere and nowhere at once.
data.tagline: One face hides a thousand schemes.
data.title: The Gambler of Voss
